# Logan Smith

> Personal website and security blog of Logan Smith, an IT Security Engineer based in Orange County, California. Covers defensive security, automation, homelab/self-hosting, and practical writeups. Small, fully public, hand-built static site — no logins, no APIs, no dynamic state.

Key facts:

- Preferred contact: Contact@logansmith.us (email, answered by a human)
- Profiles: [GitHub](https://github.com/Logans415) · [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/certified-nerd/)
- Security reports for this site: https://logansmith.us/.well-known/security.txt

## Pages

- [Home](https://logansmith.us/): about, skills and toolkit, experience, selected projects, and contact — all on one page
- [Blog](https://logansmith.us/blog.html): the authoritative, always-current index of all posts
- [RSS feed](https://logansmith.us/feed.xml): machine-readable list of the same posts
- [Acceptable Use Policy](https://logansmith.us/acceptable-use.html): what the site is for, the rules for automated access and AI crawling, and how to report a security issue

## Optional

- [Site source](https://github.com/Logans415/logansmith-us): README with stack and structure (plain HTML/CSS/JS on GitHub Pages)
